space.name: env_layout_15
space.notes: T-K part 1's basic room (Hadi's design, 3 October 2026): the tests of context knowledge on kitting, in the IRB (idle robot) and the MPB (working robot). Square, 1000 x 1000. Bearings are seen from kitting_table_0's centre (degrees, x east, y north), distances between centres. kitting_table_0 in the north-west corner at (-400, 450), against both walls; five targets fan out from it to the south and east: shelf_3 (-450, -5), -96.3 deg, 458 cm; shelf_1 (-155, -450), -74.8 deg, 933 cm; shelf_4 (150, -450), -58.6 deg, 1055 cm; coffee_machine_0 (475, -275), -39.6 deg, 1136 cm; shelf_2 (445, 150), -19.5 deg, 897 cm. corner_NE (450, 450) the one landmark, the exit walk's target; no door, no A/C switch, no obstacles. Not designed to produce a recognizer result. Stated consequences: neighbouring targets are 16.2 to 21.5 deg apart; the walks from the table are long (897 to 1136 cm) except the walk to shelf_3 (458 cm); the fixed objects' centres are at least 300 cm apart; the coffee machine's neighbours by bearing are shelf_4 (19.0 deg) and shelf_2 (20.1 deg); corner_NE's bearing (0.0 deg) is 19.5 deg from shelf_2's; no ac_activation hypothesis exists in this room, so once no delivery is live coffee_break is the one live hypothesis, whatever its strength.

env_objects.notes: The north-west corner, against both walls; the one kitting table, shared.
The south wall, west of centre; -74.8 deg from the table, 933 cm.
The east wall, north of centre; -19.5 deg from the table, 897 cm.
The east wall, south of centre; -39.6 deg from the table, 1136 cm, between shelf_4 and shelf_2 by bearing.
The west wall, at mid-height; -96.3 deg from the table, 458 cm: the one short walk.
The south wall, east of centre; -58.6 deg from the table, 1055 cm.

Landmark (T-C1): the exit walk's target; a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls. The north-east corner, not the south-east one: from kitting_table_0 corner_NE's bearing (0.0 deg) is 19.5 deg from shelf_2's and 39.6 deg from the coffee machine's, while (450, -450) would be 7.0 deg from the coffee machine's. From the coffee machine the walk here passes through shelf_2's footprint.
